To,
1. All Addl. CPFCs (Zones)
2, All Regional PF Commissioners-|
3 All Officers-in-charge of SROs

Sub: Guidelines regarding issue of Vigilance Clearance in respect of Officers and Staff working in
various offices of the organization — Reg.

Sir/Madam,

In continuation of this office letter No.Vig.XIX(1)2015/VCC/1406 dated 06-05-2015, it is
informed that in the Vigilance Review Meeting held on 17-06-2015, it has been decided that the
RPFC-I, being Disciplinar Authority/Appointing Authority shall issue VCC in respect of Group ‘C’
& Group ‘D’ employees. However, it has been observed that the officers-in-charge still
continue to refer matters for VCCs to the ZVDs in respect of Group ‘C’ and Group ‘D’
employees. As this is no appropriate, all concerned are advised not to send requisition for VCC
in respect of Group ‘C’ and Group ‘D’ employees to respective Zonal Vigilance Directorates.

(This issues with the approval of CVO)

Your: faithfully,

=a

Addl. CPFC (Vig.)

Copy to:

1. All Deputy Directors, (Vigilance), Zonal Vigilance Directorates — are herewith directed
not to issue VCC in respect of Group ‘C’ and Group ‘D’ employees.

2. RPFC, NDC, New Delhi— Delhi for uploading the same on EPF website.
